Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rgraphtool 0.5.0

Feature release adding Gram-matrix GMRF network reconstruction, multi-threaded weighted and combined layered-weighted SBMs, and weighted planted-partition community detection.

Fast PseudoNormal Reconstruction & Merge-Split DynBlockPrior

  • Added shrinkage_covariance(), a zero-dependency analytical Ledoit–Wolf / Schäfer–Strimmer covariance shrinkage estimator toward "diagonal" or "identity" targets for passing directly to pseudo_normal_block_state(cov = ..., n_eff = ...).

  • Added an exact \(O(\deg)\) sufficient-statistic Gram-matrix PseudoNormal backend (cov, n_eff arguments in pseudo_normal_block_state(), auto-enabled for sample matrices when \(M \ge 64, N \le 4{,}000\)).

  • Extended the precomputed 1D Gram edge-weight optimizer (optimize_edge_weight_pn_gram()) to both continuous Laplace and quantized MDL priors (xdist = TRUE, tdist = TRUE) via incremental \(O(\log K)\) QuantHist histogram maintenance.

  • Parallelized candidate generation (build_candidates()) and added periodic partial-residual active-set refreshes (refresh_every in reconstruct_dynamics()) so greedy reconstruction recovers zero-marginal-correlation suppressor edges.

  • Added DynBlockPrior::merge_split_sweep() (merge_split = TRUE in reconstruct_dynamics()) with BFS-seeded level-0 splits, local 2-way refinement, same-parent merges, and upper-level sweeps to escape single-block traps, plus Phase 2 finite-temperature posterior block sampling (bs_samples when nsamples > 0).

Multi-Threaded Weighted & Combined Layered-Weighted SBMs

  • Extracted shared conjugate/microcanonical edge-covariate likelihoods and sufficient statistics into src/weight_cov.h.
  • Parallelized weighted SBM coarsening and flat refinement sweeps via WeightedLevel::virtual_move_const() and virtual_merge_const(), and exposed nthreads on minimize_weighted_blockmodel_dl() and minimize_nested_weighted_blockmodel_dl().
  • Extended layered_block_state(), nested_layered_block_state(), minimize_layered_blockmodel_dl(), minimize_nested_layered_blockmodel_dl(), sample_posterior(), model_evidence(), and compare_layered_models() to jointly model discrete edge layers and edge covariates (weights, types, params) under both pooled (independent = FALSE / "edge_covariates") and layer-stratified (independent = TRUE / "independent_layers") models, with parallel greedy sweeps (nthreads) and Rcpp::Nullable C++ default bindings.

Weighted & Layered Planted-Partition SBMs

  • Extended pp_block_state(), minimize_pp_blockmodel_dl(), pp_assortativity(), compare_assortative_models(), and native PP MCMC (mcmc_sweep(), mcmc_equilibrate(), mcmc_anneal(), sample_posterior(), model_evidence()) to support edge covariates (weights, types, params), discrete edge layers (independent = FALSE or TRUE), and simultaneous layered-weighted inference across 2 (uniform = TRUE) or \(B + 1\) (uniform = FALSE) weight buckets per stratum with \(O(\deg(v))\) incremental moves.
  • Added pp_edge_covariates, pp_independent_layers, pp_edge_covariates_uniform, and pp_independent_layers_uniform options to compare_layered_models(), weight_in_mean / weight_out_mean and per-layer (*_layer, err_layer) diagnostics to pp_assortativity(), weighted model dispatch against flat and nested weighted SBMs in compare_assortative_models(), and explicit caveats documentation in ?pp_block_state (pooled inter-community out weights, mean-ordering / sign symmetry particularly at \(B = 2\), and extension beyond upstream graph-tool 3.9).

rgraphtool 0.4.0

Initial public release of rgraphtool, a standalone native R/C++23 port of Python graph-tool 3.9 with zero Python runtime dependency.

Core Graphs, Property Maps & Interoperability

  • Native boost::adj_list directed and undirected multigraphs with self-loops, parallel edges, and reference-semantics graph, vertex, and edge property maps (graph_create(), graph_set_graph_property(), graph_set_vertex_property(), graph_set_edge_property(), and print.rgraphtool_graph() with compact ASCII adjacency previews for small graphs).
  • Native C++ reader and writer for graph-tool’s .gt binary format (read_gt(), write_gt()), supporting version 1, little- and big-endian encoding, all 15 property map value types, and automatic gzip/bzip2/xz/zstd compression.
  • Lossless bidirectional igraph conversion (as_igraph(), from_igraph()) and format-detecting graph_load() / graph_save() (.gt, .graphml, .gml, .edgelist).
  • Bundled data loaders for Netzschleuder (netzschleuder_network()), the football benchmark (football_network()), and the Vacher et al. (2008) ecological fungus–tree dataset (fungus_tree_network()).

Bayesian Stochastic Block Model (SBM) Inference

  • Flat & nested (hierarchical) SBMs: exact microcanonical description lengths, multilevel agglomerative minimization, and refinement (block_state(), minimize_blockmodel_dl(), nested_block_state(), minimize_nested_blockmodel_dl(), compare_blockmodels()).
  • Posterior MCMC & partition modes: single-node and merge-split MCMC, equilibration, annealing, Hungarian label alignment, vertex marginals, consensus estimates, and mode clustering (mcmc_sweep(), mcmc_equilibrate(), mcmc_anneal(), sample_posterior(), partition_mode_state(), mode_cluster_state()).
  • Overlapping SBMs & model evidence: flat and nested overlapping SBMs and callback-free Bayesian marginal evidence (overlap_block_state(), nested_overlap_block_state(), model_evidence(), compare_model_classes()).
  • Weighted & layered SBMs: all five Peixoto (2018) edge-covariate models (real-exponential, real-normal, discrete-geometric, discrete-poisson, discrete-binomial) with exact change-of-variables log-Jacobians (transform_weights(), compare_weight_models()), plus edge-covariate and independent-layers SBMs (layered_block_state(), compare_layered_models()).
  • Assortative, ordered (ranked) & bipartite SBMs: planted-partition SBMs (pp_block_state()), flat/nested ordered SBMs (ranked_block_state(), plot_ranked_hierarchy()), and native microcanonical flat, nested, and weighted bipartite SBMs (bipartite_graph(), minimize_bipartite_blockmodel_dl(), minimize_nested_bipartite_blockmodel_dl(), plot_bipartite()).

Network Reconstruction

  • Uncertain networks & triadic closure: measured, mixed-measured, uncertain, latent Poisson multigraph, and multi-generation latent triadic closure models (measured_block_state(), mixed_measured_block_state(), uncertain_block_state(), latent_multigraph(), reconstruct_network(), predict_edges(), latent_closure_block_state(), infer_triadic_closure()).
  • Reconstruction from dynamics & behavior: all 10 dynamical models (equilibrium/Glauber Ising & continuous Ising, compartmental epidemics, Gaussian/linear-normal, and \(q\)-state Potts) with L1 regularization paths, quantized MDL priors, and native forward simulators (reconstruct_dynamics(), reconstruct_l1_path(), simulate_ising(), simulate_epidemics(), simulate_normal_dynamics(), simulate_potts()).

Centrality, Topology, Random Graphs & Modularity

  • Multi-threaded C++23 centrality (pagerank(), betweenness(), closeness(), eigenvector_centrality(), katz_centrality(), hits_centrality()), shortest paths (shortest_distance(), shortest_path(), pseudo_diameter(), graph_diameter()), connectivity (label_components(), label_biconnected_components(), topological_sort(), is_dag()), clustering (local_clustering(), global_clustering()), and assortativity().
  • Fast random graph generators (random_graph_erdos_renyi(), random_graph_barabasi_albert(), random_graph_watts_strogatz(), random_graph_configuration(), random_graph_sbm()).
  • modularity() and maximize_modularity() (with explicit statistical overfitting warnings mirroring graph-tool’s ModularityState).

Visualization, Scaling & C++ Extensions

  • Native Barnes–Hut SFDP layouts (sfdp_layout()), standalone zero-dependency HTML5 Canvas animations and interactive BFS explorer (animate_sirs(), animate_dynamic_layout(), interactive_bfs()), base-R/grid/ggplot2 vector/raster plotting (plot_graph(), graph_grob(), ggplot_graph(), save_graph_plot()), and offline cartographic map projections (plot_graph_map()).
  • Portable C++23 std::thread parallelism (rgraphtool_set_num_threads()) and a public <rgraphtool.h> C++ extension interface (LinkingTo: rgraphtool, Rcpp, BH, compile_cpp_extension(), kcore_decomposition()).
